limitations: Existing synthetic development games; replay is not an independent sample or new performance evaluation.
One faction faces one commander; the other faces two. Role decisions cannot be pooled as unique actor opportunities.
Readiness covers named attacks, not all attacks; specials are classified separately. Public invulnerability blocks targeting; charged primordial guards do not.
Knowledge derives from own facts, public reveal or constraint inference; trusted reports and claims remain uncertain.
Repeated active choices are correlated; game and seed counts are supplied.
Target selection and skill effects are descriptive, not isolated causes of faction win imbalance.
